UserSession.title: UserSession
UserSession.description: Isolated Puzzle #71 keyspace session keyed by normalized Bitcoin payout address.

shareToken.description: 128-bit URL-safe share token for multi-device URL (?u=...) access (immutable).

blockMode.description: Block leasing strategy for this address.

seqCursor.description: Next sequential 2^29 block index as decimal string.

totalKeysChecked.description: Monotonic cumulative count of scanned keys across all blocks for this address.

completedBlocksCount.description: Cumulative count of PoW-verified completed 2^29 blocks.

activeLeasedCount.description: Current count of active in-progress leased blocks.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last session update.

ShareTokenLookup.title: ShareTokenLookup
ShareTokenLookup.description: Immutable mapping from URL shareToken to normalized btcAddress.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when mapping was created.

SessionDevice.title: SessionDevice
SessionDevice.description: Ephemeral browser compute worker instance under a Bitcoin address session.

gpuName.description: Detected WebGPU adapter or CPU fallback description.

lastRateKps.description: Last measured throughput in keys per second.

keysChecked.description: Cumulative keys checked by this device instance.

blocksCompleted.description: Cumulative blocks completed by this device instance.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of the last heartbeat or checkpoint.

SearchedBlock.title: SearchedBlock
SearchedBlock.description: Canonical 2^29 keyspace block leased or completed under a Bitcoin address session.

startKeyHex.description: Inclusive starting hex key of the block (immutable).

endKeyHex.description: Inclusive ending hex key of the block (immutable).

status.description: Block lifecycle state; completed is terminal and immutable.

deviceId.description: Device ID currently owning or having completed the block.

progressOffset.description: Monotonic keys scanned inside this block [0, totalKeys].

powOffsets.description: Bounded array (<= 64) of verified integer Proof-of-Work key offsets.

powCount.description: Count of verified PoW shares matching powOffsets.size().

leasedAt.description: Server timestamp when the block was leased (immutable).

heartbeatAt.description: Server timestamp of the last lease heartbeat or progress checkpoint.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp when completed, or null while leased.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public anonymized solver leaderboard entry (PII-isolated: no full BTC address or shareToken).

maskedAddress.description: Masked Bitcoin address showing only prefix and suffix.

totalKeysChecked.description: Monotonic total keys scanned for this address.

lastActivityAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent compute activity.

RelayAuditLog.title: RelayAuditLog
RelayAuditLog.description: Immutable record of a private pool transaction broadcast attempt.

isDryRun.description: Whether this was a Puzzle #5 dry-run or mainnet broadcast.

/sessions/{btcAddress}.description: Primary per-Bitcoin-address session root keyed by normalized btcAddress.

/share_tokens/{shareToken}.description: Direct lookup from shareToken (?u=...) to normalized btcAddress.

/sessions/{btcAddress}/devices/{deviceId.description: Ephemeral device records for an address session.

/sessions/{btcAddress}/blocks/{blockInde.description: Unique 2^29 keyspace blocks for an address session.

/sessions/{btcAddress}/relay_submissions.description: Immutable private relay audit log for winning key claim broadcasts.

/leaderboard/{addressHash}.description: Public anonymized leaderboard keyed by SHA-256 hex digest of btcAddress.
